---
name: commit-message
description: >
  Write a conventional commit message from the staged or working tree diff.
  Use when the user asks for a commit message or is ready to commit.
---

# Commit message

1. Read the diff that would be committed.
2. Choose a type such as feat, fix, docs, or refactor.
3. Write a subject of at most 72 characters in the imperative mood.
4. Add a body only when the reason for the change is not obvious from the subject.
